messages:
ashley (AE): Ok team — FinBank POC confirmed in a sealed datacenter. They want a 6-week POC with no internet egress. Need clarity on: bundle format, how we deliver deltas/patches, upgrade cadence options, and a preliminary cost estimate. Any red flags?

diego (SE): We can support. A few constraints to call out: 1) airgap = signed bundles + offline activation; 2) delta updates possible but need careful compatibility testing; 3) verify they can run our operator with privileged mounts for KV cache.

mira (Eng-ops): Quick answers: we support tarball minibundles (gz) and chunked deltas. We produce signed artifacts (offline signer) and an SBOM per release. For HSM/KMS — customer-managed KMS is supported for Private. For fully sealed POCs we offer a signing service that signs bundles with a short-lived cert we hand off.

ashley (AE): Nice. For the commercial ask — customer expects (a) initial on-prem packaging and validation, (b) up to 8 delta patches during POC, (c) runbook + remote support window. Can you draft rough fees?

diego (SE): Rough engineering/ops estimate (POC scope):
- packaging & validation (one-time): $4,500
- per-delta build + signing (if we build): $350 each -> for 8 = $2,800
- support (phone/Slack) retainer for POC: $3,000 / month
- optional on-site/remote debug day: $1,200 / day
These are ballpark — legal may want to convert to SOW line items.

mira (Eng-ops): Operational notes and blockers:
- Upgrade cadence: we can do 'security-only' deltas on customer request, typically 30–90 day patch channel. Full upgrades (model/runtime bumps) are a separate bundle and need compatibility testing.
- Compatibility window: we guarantee delta apply compatibility for up to 2 minor runtime releases; beyond that we recommend full bundle.
- Rollback: we generate a signed rollback bundle; customer must provide a plan for state snapshot (KV cache) before applying patches.

ashley (AE): Good — they also want security questionnaire answers for: FIPS support, outbound telemetry, SBOM, signing chain, cert rotation cadence. Diego can you list exact fields we should answer?

diego (SE): I'll compile the short answers. Off the top:
- FIPS mode: runtime can be built with FIPS-compliant crypto (requires custom build)
- Telemetry: in airgap we disable outbound telemetry by default; optional opt-in via customer-approved egress
- SBOM: produced per release (CycloneDX)
- Signing chain: we can provide RSA-4096 signed artifacts; if they require HSM attestation we integrate with their HSM for signing ops
- Cert rotation: recommended 1 year for bundle signing certs; we can automate rotation but in airgap it's a manual exchange step

deploy-bot: artifact-builder: build/1753210000/minibundle-2026-03-10.tar.gz completed, sha256: 3a7f5d9c2b8e6c4f8d1e9b2aef4c9e7b0d2a3f4c5e6d7c8b9a0f1e2d3c4b5a6

mira (Eng-ops): Action items:
- I'll produce a 1-page POC runbook (install steps, maintenance window template, rollback steps, signing handshake)
- Diego: pls prepare the security Q&A bullets and a pared-down SBOM sample
- Ashley: pls confirm pricing tolerance with the customer and whether they want us to build deltas or hand them patch tooling
ETA: I can have the runbook + sample signed minibundle by EOD Tue. @ashley @diego :thumbsup:

ashley (AE): Perfect — I'll send the SOW draft and a calendar invite for a 30-min ops handoff tomorrow. Thanks!
